name: @calliope/android
description: Capacitor shell that ships the built web app as an Android APK.

scripts._comment:sync: Builds the web app with the API origin baked in, then copies it into the native project. VITE_API_ORIGIN is required: unlike the web deployment, the APK has no same-origin backend to fall back on.
scripts.sync: npm run build -w @calliope/web && cap sync android
